package a name=a dir=a module=
  file a/a.synod
  deps 
targets a
module "" dir=. version= synod=9.1 requires=1
diagnostics 5
synod.mod:1:1: error[syntax]: "module" takes one module path
  hint: write "module <path>"
synod.mod:2:1: error[syntax]: unknown directive "modul"
  hint: directives are "module", "synod" and "require"
synod.mod:3:1: error[syntax]: module needs Synod 9.1; this compiler implements 0.3
synod.mod:4:1: error[syntax]: bad version "1.2"
  hint: a version looks like "v1.2.0"
synod.mod:6:1: error[syntax]: module "github.com/a/c" is required twice
